assessments.note: Istanbul/Pera Palace is a tradition; the same page says she wrote the first part at the Baron Hotel in Aleppo.

support.quote: Detective writer Agatha Christie's 1934 novel Murder on the Orient Express was allegedly written in the Pera Palace Hotel.

assessments.note: 'allegedly'; the hotel keeps room 411 as a memorial. The wording now says 'according to tradition'.

assessments.note: Same page: opened at the Ambassadors Theatre on 25 November 1952.
